adjudication.rationale: The diff *does* update JS tests to cover the new plural `_ids` hydration (create-pretender adds `color_ids`/`colors`, and `store-test.js.es6` asserts `f.get('colors')`), so the finding’s “no JS test / store-test not updated” portion is incorrect. However, the new branch in `store.js.es6` does call `obj[k].map(...)` without guarding that `obj[k]` is an array, so a `null` (or non-array) `*_ids` payload would throw at runtime. Also, if `_lookupSubType` can’t find an id in the root collection, the resulting array will contain `undefined` entries (no filtering), which is a real edge-case robustness concern introduced by this change.
